{{Quote|The Twi'lek vibroblade master from Ord Mantell? Gone. The Chiss droid builder fond of explosives? Gone. That just leaves your protege to remove.|Tarro Blood|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] '''droid builder''' and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was fond of using explosives attempted to enter the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] in [[3643 BBY]], but [[Tarro Blood]] had his crew sabotage the Chiss, successfully eliminating the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] builder as Blood's competition.
